Printfection is now Swag Pro 
 
 
Printfection is evolving. By unifying with Swag.com, we’re delivering an upgraded suite of enterprise tools designed for the modern organization. From global fulfillment to strategic account support, discover Swag Pro - the platform built to fit the way you work.
 
 
 
 
Get a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Printfection is now Swag Pro 
 
 
Printfection is evolving. By unifying with Swag.com, we’re delivering an upgraded suite of enterprise tools designed for the modern organization. From global fulfillment to strategic account support, discover Swag Pro - the platform built to fit the way you work.

Tanya H. | Brand Design Director
Printfection is the best of the best
I like the ease of use of the platform and the willingness of the team to provide new ideas. I'm also appreciative of how the team goes the extra mile to research and source, and then consult with our team to solve complex problems.
 
Staci C. | Channel Marketing Manager
Best platform for event giveaways, customer thank you gifts, and stirring up new business
I would highly, highly recommend trying Printfection before any of the other gift-giving services.  You can give cost allotments to your sales team and send out individual redemption links to customers or prospects.
 
Katherine E. | Public Relations Account Executive

Printfection's product and CS team is outstanding.

Printing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get your company's logo and artwork printed on just about anything
 
 
Brand hoodies, t-shirts, drinkware, Giant jenga sets — you name it
 
Get free samples & custom mockups so you know your brand looks good
 
We offer various printing methods like screen printing, embroidery, debossing, laser engraving, etc.
 
We'll create your products and store them for you — no more swag closet in your office or home!

Swag giveaways
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Create your giveaway link
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Create a link to a branded gifting offer page. You can customize this page with your company's look and feel.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Send gifts
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The recipient selects their gift, then enters their own shipping address. Swag Pro then handles all the shipping from there!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get detailed reporting
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get access to tracking information and who has redeemed what so your team can follow up.

Internal store fronts
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Create internal stores where users can request swag and you can control what gets sent through an approval and budget process.
 
This is perfect for giving customers, employees, or reps a place where they can request swag.

Powerful reporting
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Track budgets, POs, and spend. Know what’s popular and when to reorder.

Topnotch customer support
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get the level of help you need by plan, including 1:1 strategy, ideas, and support.
 
 
We handle all the hard stuff: fulfillment, customs, delivery, and more
 
Qualifying plans provide you with your own dedicated customer success manager to help you pick the right swag and guidance on how to best use it
 
Manage all your swag orders and logistics in one place
 
We'll help you with any swag or shipping issues

Custom Plans
 
 
Don't see what you are looking for? Let's talk about a custom plan that is right for your unique needs and budget
 
 
 
 
Talk to sales
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What do you get in a centralized swag platform? 
 
 
Receive all these benefits for a single warehouse & servicing fee — 
no nickel and diming.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sourcing & Printing
 
Brand promo products from an expansive item catalog, including access to premium and exclusive brands. Various print methods (screenprinting, embroidery, debossing & more).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shipping & Fulfillment
 
Complete ownership of logistics (storage, shipping, customs, returns, compliance). Platform enables customers to send to individuals or locations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Kitting & Custom Packaging
 
Create an unforgettable gifting experience with swag kits containing multiple items. Choose from our standard options or customize boxes, polybags, and tape for an elevated brand experience.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reporting
 
Monitor budget, inventory, spend, and delivery tracking in our easy-to-use platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Integrations
 
Send swag with marketing automation tools, CRM, & other direct API connections. Have custom integration needs? Let's talk.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Service
 
Our dedicated CS and Ops teams provide white-glove service to get the most out of your swag programs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What do you get in a centralized swag platform? 
 
 
Receive all these benefits for a single warehouse & servicing fee — 
no nickel and diming.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sourcing & Printing
 
Brand promo products from an expansive item catalog, including access to premium and exclusive brands. Various print methods (screenprinting, embroidery, debossing & more).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shipping & Fulfillment
 
Complete ownership of logistics (storage, shipping, customs, returns, compliance). Platform enables customers to send to individuals or locations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Kitting & Custom Packaging
 
Create an unforgettable gifting experience with swag kits containing multiple items. Choose from our standard options or customize boxes, polybags, and tape for an elevated brand experience.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reporting
 
Monitor budget, inventory, spend, and delivery tracking in our easy-to-use platform.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Integrations
 
Send swag with marketing automation tools, CRM, & other direct API connections. Have custom integration needs? Let's talk.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Service

 What do you get in a centralized swag platform? 
 
 
Receive all these benefits for a single warehouse & servicing fee — 
no nickel and diming.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sourcing & Printing
 
Brand promo products from an expansive item catalog, including access to premium and exclusive brands. Various print methods (screenprinting, embroidery, debossing & more).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Shipping & Fulfillment
 
Complete ownership of logistics (storage, shipping, customs, returns, compliance). Platform enables customers to send to individuals or locations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Kitting & Custom Packaging
 
Create an unforgettable gifting experience with swag kits containing multiple items. Choose from our standard options or customize boxes, polybags, and tape for an elevated brand experience.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reporting
 
Monitor budget, inventory, spend, and delivery tracking in our easy-to-use platform.

FAQs
 
Expand
 
 
 
FAQs
 
How do these pricing plans work?
 You pay a flat monthly price to use Printfection's swag management platform. Backed by a network of product vendors, printers, and fulfillment centers, we're an end-to-end swag management solution. Discounted rates are available for annual subscription plans.
 
What other costs are involved?
 
Your only additional costs are:
 
 
Product Price — The cost of the actual printed products purchased
 
Fulfillment Charge — Small charges for handling and packing each order
 
Shipping Cost — A calculated cost for each shipment you send
 
 
What payment methods are available?
 There are two payment methods that can be used.
 
Account Balance:
 Your account can be pre-funded via invoice. Charges are then pulled from your balance.
 
Credit Card:
 Printfection supports multiple credit cards per account. Your monthly subscription will be charged to your primary card.
 If you choose not to use your Account Balance, your card will be used for product, fulfillment, and shipping charges.
 
Are the pricing plans annual?
 Our pricing plans are flexible, month-to-month commitments. We do offer annual discounts if you sign up for one year.
 
Do we have to source swag through Printfection?
 No, we have a feature that allows you to source swag from other vendors and ship in your existing inventory when you come onboard. Enterprise customers are able to send items throughout your subscription.
 
Are pricing plans required to partner with Printfection?
 Yes, since everything is managed through our platform, a plan is required to utilize our technology, warehousing services and receive support from our customer team.
